# Count accepted records by tag

Once the report carries the `tags` column, operations want the same breakdown in the counts:
have `src/summarise.py::summarise()` return an additional `by_tag` mapping from each tag to the
number of accepted records carrying it.

Notes for the implementer:

- The tags come from the same normalised field the report column reads, so this must land after
  that column exists — the two have to agree on what a tag is.
- `src/report.py` is fully covered — see `tests/test_report.py`, 12 tests — so a change there is
  well protected if you need one.
- Tags are already split for you by `check_record()`; do not re-split the raw column.
